notes.title: Welcome to our Store Page!
notes.content:
Hello steam user who randomly found this game!

My name is Spencer Pilarski. I am a game developer and member of 4/5 Dentists along with Snippy Nguyen, Jonah Gaynor, and Sam Grant.

This is the store page for our little game Escape Velocity, a project we worked on for a few months in the first half of 2018. Its a small narrative focused 2D runner.

We hope you enjoy it!

If you have any questions or suggestions or criticisms feel free to leave a review or reach out to me directly:
Twitter: @expomunkeh
Steam username : expomonkey
